tools.name: koskamo_retrieve
tools.description: Look up cited passages from public Koskamo datasets so an agent can answer from facts instead of guessing.

tools.name: koskamo_list_datasets
tools.description: List public Koskamo datasets an agent may retrieve from.

tools.name: koskamo_propose_revision
tools.description: Propose a better fact for a dataset, propose reverting a document to an earlier version, or propose deleting a document. The change stays pending until a dataset owner approves it.

tools.name: koskamo_get_history
tools.description: Get the document version timeline for a public dataset: every document (including deleted ones) with the version history produced by approved revisions.

tools.name: koskamo_list_revisions
tools.description: List pending revisions for a dataset.

tools.name: koskamo_decide_revision
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending revision. Requires the dataset owner's API key or KNOWLEDGE_ADMIN_KEY. Approved text is chunked and becomes retrievable.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "koskamo_register_mcp_server" is 1040 chars, far longer than this server's median (150). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: koskamo_find_mcp_server, koskamo_register_mcp_server · Private data: koskamo_propose_revision, koskamo_get_history, koskamo_decide_revision, koskamo_register_mcp_server · Public sink: koskamo_register_mcp_server · Destructive: koskamo_find_mcp_server.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: koskamo_find_mcp_server, koskamo_register_mcp_server · Private data: koskamo_propose_revision, koskamo_get_history, koskamo_decide_revision, koskamo_register_mcp_server · Public sink: koskamo_register_mcp_server · Destructive: koskamo_find_mcp_server

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
